title: Add docstrings to EventBus public methods
acceptance: Every public method and property has a concise docstring; `python3 -m unittest vira.tests.test_event_bus -v` still passes.

title: Add EventBus subscribe, publish, unsubscribe and wildcard tests
acceptance: New tests cover subscribe, publish, unsubscribe, a wildcard subscriber and a slow subscriber; `python3 -m unittest vira.tests.test_event_bus -v` passes.

title: Document the `vira doctor --json` schema and add a shape test
acceptance: The JSON keys are documented and a test asserts the report contains ok/counts/checks with name/status/summary.

title: Add a sensor → event → agent → answer example
acceptance: A new example shows the event name, dispatcher path, agent subscription and the visible result, with real code references.

title: Add an HTTP route test for the hello-world plugin
acceptance: A test calls the plugin route handler or mounted router and asserts the greeting and persisted request count.

title: Add a client test for collector permission and unavailable states
acceptance: A Flutter unit test asserts permission_denied and unavailable are surfaced without throwing; `flutter test` passes.

title: Add a docs link checker to CI
acceptance: A script reports broken relative links in README/docs and fails CI when a new broken link is introduced.

title: Improve keyboard and screen-reader labels on dashboard buttons
acceptance: Icon-only buttons have descriptive aria-labels and focus-visible styling; the page still works without a mouse.

title: Add an API test for resuming a failed run
acceptance: A TestClient test resumes a failed run with its original message and asserts a new run is returned without duplicating the user message.

title: Add type hints to the plugin context registration methods
acceptance: Registration methods have precise type hints and the plugin examples still load and pass `vira.tests.test_examples`.
